name: codex-reset-request
description: Event-driven local Codex usage-limit detector with an optional Bird-powered X reset request action.

scripts.test:x-read: pnpm run build:dist && node dist/reset/cli.js test x-read
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:biome && pnpm run lint:oxlint
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --import-plugin --node-plugin --vitest-plugin -A vitest/no-conditional-expect -A vitest/require-mock-type-parameters -A vitest/require-to-throw-message --deny-warnings src tests scripts
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:biome:fix && pnpm run lint:oxlint:fix
scripts.lint:oxlint:fix: oxlint --import-plugin --node-plugin --vitest-plugin -A vitest/no-conditional-expect -A vitest/require-mock-type-parameters -A vitest/require-to-throw-message --deny-warnings --fix src tests scripts
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run verify:no-polling && pnpm run verify:no-secrets && pnpm run verify:attribution
